## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- Claims 2–5 depend on an unproved identification of the computed cokernel with \(J_v/\Lambda_+J_v\). The Schur basis for \(J_v\), box truncation, and sufficiency of the \(e_k\)-Pieri relations must be justified or the results marked conditional.
- The artifact suppresses the complete Smith diagonal and relation-matrix rank; its field `rank` is instead the cokernel free rank. This prevents independent checking of the asserted torsion invariants.
- The custom Smith routine has no independent certificate or cross-check.
- Claim 5 is a degenerate \(n-r>5\) example with \(a=0\) and \(N=1\). A representative nontrivial case with \(n-r>5\), \(r\ge2\), and \(N>1\) remains missing.
- “Smallest admissible” is not defined by an ordering of parameter tuples. Finite outputs cannot establish the universal conjecture.
